name: Ashamed
overview: Scripture teaches that being ashamed of Christ and His words carries serious consequences, as both Mark 8:38 and Luke 9:26 warn that the Son of Man will be ashamed of those who deny Him at His coming. Conversely, Romans 1:16 encourages believers to boldly embrace the gospel without shame, recognizing it as the power of God for salvation. The call to submit to God and resist the devil in James 4:7 underscores the importance of steadfast faith, while Hebrews 10:26 warns of the grave danger in willfully sinning after receiving the truth, which can lead to a loss of the sacrifice for sins. Together, these verses emphasize the necessity of unwavering allegiance to Christ and the gospel, free from shame.
